verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a cap table platform, so programmatic agent access to equity data is a fair axis. The evidence shows only manual report downloads (extended and summary reports), a built-in data room, and a site-level llms.txt that describes the company. Nothing documents an API, MCP server, or other programmatic endpoint an agent could use to pull the cap table and reconcile it against the data room.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
